Mitsui & Co. is a massive global trading and investment conglomerate rather than a single-brand retailer
. Instead of selling specific consumer labels, it distributes
commodities, industrial materials, chemicals, energy, and food resources
through a vast network of subsidiaries, joint ventures, and partnerships across sectors like automotive, agriculture, and retail.

Food and Agriculture
Ventura Foods:
Joint venture producing margarine, shortening, and dressings.
Certis USA:
Biopesticide manufacturing and distribution.
Mitsui Foods & Mitsui Alimentos:
Distributes canned goods, juices, and coffee brands.

Tissavel:
High-end luxury faux fur distribution in Europe.

Seven & i Holdings (7-Eleven):
Logistics and demand chain support services provider.
QVC Japan:
Television and digital home shopping network joint venture.
